Container.Name: shortcircuit
Container.Overview: Self-hosted URL shortener and link management. Build the local image before installing this template. Use an SSH tunnel for the default loopback ports or configure a private reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent data on a local pool. Use the direct path for your pool and grant UID and GID 10001 write access.

Config.Name: Public hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated hostnames for public redirects on port 8080.

Config.Name: Admin origin
Config.Description: Browser origin for the admin listener on port 8081. Set the exact HTTPS origin when using a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Backup interval
Config.Description: Scheduled backup interval in hours. Use 0 to disable automatic backups.

Config.Name: Scheduled backups to keep
Config.Description: Number of verified scheduled backups to retain.
